messages:
mike_dev: Heads up — main pipeline turned red right after that merge. Failing on smoke/gpu-kvcache step, seen as an OOM. cc @jordan @sara_reliability

jordan: on it, can you paste the failing step output and the job id?

mike_dev: job id 1903456789. log snippet below:
```text
--- step: smoke/gpu-kvcache ---
Error: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 12.00 GiB (requested 12.00 GiB)
  at runtime/alloc.cu:452
Command: pytest tests/inference/test_kv_cache.py::test_prefix_caching -q
--- end ---
```

sara_reliability: did the merge change default batch sizes / quantization flags? I remember a tweak to kernel configs in that PR.

jordan: checking the diff now. PR #4275 touched runtime/alloc and a default in serving/config. Suspect new alloc pattern + caching pref -> spike.

mike_dev: it was a small perf tweak, shouldn't change memory. but will repro locally.

jordan: quick experiment: @ci-bot rerun 1903456789 with env SKIP_KV_CACHE=1 (to confirm cache is the factor)

ci-bot: Accepted: rerun queued as 1903456789-rerun-1. Parameters: {"env": "SKIP_KV_CACHE=1"} ETA ~6m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oncall-jen: if rerun fails we should bisect between main@~3 and main@~1. add bisect metadata to the job so we can automate the bisection. also ping infra-team if we need fast revert.

mike_dev: adding bisect labels + reproducer command to the CI job now. will post once rerun finishes.

jordan: i pulled the failed build cache and repro locally; with SKIP_KV_CACHE=1 it doesn't OOM. indicates caching alloc path is the suspect. good call.

ci-bot: Rebuild 1903456789-rerun-1 finished: all smoke tests passed :white_check_mark: (duration 5m 12s)

mike_dev: update: rerun passed. looks like transient allocation spike triggered by new kernel warmup + caching. I'll open a follow-up PR to add safer alloc guards and a canary on the kernel change.

oncall-jen: thanks everyone. monitoring for 10m then closing incident if stable.

mike_dev: closing — no further failures after 20m. :tada:
